items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: the pianist was Pete Zeeveld... I used to just sit there with my freshman beanie on and listen to these old men.

ctx.x: And anyway, that entire band, which I became aware of by listening to these sounds coming out of Carnegie dorm, they used to get together for jam sessions every week in © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

Silliman Hall. And the band at that time was Bob Krompart on cornet, Collier on trombone, John Fell was the clarinetist, the pianist was Pete Zeeveld, and Mike Beldock, who had a distinguished career as an attorney and still does, was the drummer in the band. And anyway I used to just sit there with my freshman beanie on and listen to these old men.
